purpose: Evaluate trajectory preflight, preprocessing, observables, sampling, source data and evidence boundaries.

cases.task: Design analysis for a protein-ligand trajectory.
must_include: topology mapping units frames and replicas
fit and analysis selections with reference
must_not: list every available metric without rationale
promise a binding or mechanism conclusion

cases.task: Assess whether topology and trajectories are ready for analysis.
must_include: atom count order and residue mapping
frame count time step stride and units
periodic box restart and corruption checks
must_not: continue when atom mapping is unresolved

cases.task: Run RMSD, RMSF and contact analysis on a tutorial trajectory.
must_include: exact selections reference and analysis window
tool versions commands or code entrypoint
must_not: call a plateau proof of equilibrium or binding

cases.task: Compare two conditions with several simulation replicas.
must_include: exploratory claim language and next validation
must_not: attribute differences to mechanism without orthogonal evidence

cases.task: Audit an MD report that claims stable ligand binding.
must_include: trace from figures to topology trajectories and parameters
selection reference PBC and window review
unsupported inference and safe replacement language
must_not: accept RMSD plateau as binding evidence

cases.task: Handle a short single-replica trajectory that cannot answer the intended comparison.
must_include: what additional evidence could change the conclusion

cases.task: A biased trajectory has readable frames but lacks physical time and production provenance.
must_not: assume reader time is physical time
